migrations.name: 0005_identity_providers.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.sql:
-- One-time owner sign-in links minted by `rer signin` with the deployment's own
-- Cloudflare credentials, written straight into this table through the D1 API.
-- Apply as a NEW numbered migration under the seed's next unused number; never
-- rewrite an applied migration. Additive only. token_hash is the SHA-256 of the
-- link token (owner-signin-grant.mjs); the token itself is never stored.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_owner_signins (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, consumed_at INTEGER
);

migrations.sql:
-- Secure message content stays in the clinic database. Only token hashes live
-- here; private links are credentials and are excluded from clinic archives.
CREATE TABLE bm_message_links (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, client_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bm_clients(id),
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT, opened_at TEXT,
 delivery TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(delivery IN ('email','shown')),
 delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(delivery_state IN ('pending','sent','shown','no_email','mail_unavailable'))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bm_message_link_live ON bm_message_links(client_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE bm_messages (
 sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 client_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bm_clients(id),
 sender TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(sender IN ('clinic','patient')),
 author_name TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
 sent_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 notification_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(notification_state IN ('pending','sent','shown','no_email','mail_unavailable')),
 notified_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX bm_messages_client ON bm_messages(client_id,sequence);

-- Retain the conversation as part of the health record, including after staff
-- access changes. Delivery metadata can change; the message itself cannot.
CREATE TRIGGER bm_message_content_fixed BEFORE UPDATE ON bm_messages
 WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.sequence IS NOT OLD.sequence OR NEW.client_id IS NOT OLD.client_id
 OR NEW.sender IS NOT OLD.sender OR NEW.author_name IS NOT OLD.author_name OR NEW.body IS NOT OLD.body OR NEW.sent_at IS NOT OLD.sent_at
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'message_content_fixed'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER bm_message_kept BEFORE DELETE ON bm_messages
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'messages_are_health_records'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER bm_message_client_retained BEFORE UPDATE OF erased_at ON bm_clients
 WHEN NEW.erased_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bm_messages WHERE client_id=OLD.id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'clients_with_health_records_are_retained'); END;

-- Balm: no clinic time zone is assumed. 0015 seeded Australia/Brisbane; an
-- install whose owner never chose a zone and has no visits starts with none, and
-- the owner picks it (filled from their browser) before the app or online
-- booking opens. A zone the owner saved, or one visits were booked in, is kept.
UPDATE bm_settings SET time_zone='' WHERE time_zone_chosen=0 AND time_zone='Australia/Brisbane' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bm_appointments);

-- HIPAA-004: automatic encrypted backups to storage the owner controls. The credentials are sealed under
-- the install's secret and the encryption key is the owner's public key (Balm never holds the private half).
-- Neither table travels in a .rer archive: credentials never do, and a restored clinic has its own history.
CREATE TABLE bm_backup_settings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
  endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL, bucket TEXT NOT NULL, prefix TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  access_key_id TEXT NOT NULL, secret_sealed TEXT NOT NULL, secret_hint TEXT NOT NULL,
  public_key TEXT NOT NULL, key_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  interval_hours INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24 CHECK(interval_hours IN (1,6,12,24)),
  consent_by TEXT NOT NULL, consent_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_by TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  checked_at TEXT, check_ok INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(check_ok IN (0,1)), check_message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE TABLE bm_backup_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(trigger IN ('schedule','manual')),
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','ok','failed')),
  object_key TEXT, bytes INTEGER, content_hash TEXT, key_fingerprint TEXT,
  recovery_point TEXT, counts TEXT, error TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX bm_backup_runs_started ON bm_backup_runs(started_at);
